metadata.title: Alessandro Amella | Software Engineer (LLM systems), MSc student in Aarhus
metadata.description: Software engineer and MSc Computer Science (AI) student at Aarhus University. I build production software in TypeScript and Python, more and more of it with LLMs inside, and I measure how well it works. Looking for a student job in Aarhus.

homepage.description:
Software engineer from Modena, now in Aarhus , where I'm doing an MSc in Computer Science (AI specialisation) at Aarhus University.

Since 2024 I've worked as a freelancer, taking client projects from the first call to production: requirements, quotes, database and architecture design, development, deployment on Google Cloud and AWS, and maintenance.

As more client projects are built around AI integration, much of my work is on LLM systems, and I care about measuring how well they work: my BSc thesis benchmarked LLMs against classic scrapers for data extraction. I mostly write TypeScript and Python, and some of my software runs close to hardware, from bus announcements to an ESP32 customer display. I'm looking for a student job in Aarhus, 15-20 hours a week.

freelance.description: Client projects from the first call to production: requirements, quotes, database and architecture design, development, cloud deployment (Google Cloud, AWS, VPS) and maintenance. Telemedicine, e-commerce, industrial IoT and accounting software, mostly in TypeScript with NestJS and PostgreSQL, with LLM features where they help.

sciopero.title: Web Scraping & LLMs
sciopero.description: Bachelor's thesis and empirical case study on LLM-based information extraction. An LLM pipeline reads unstructured Italian public-transport strike notices and pulls out structured data, such as dates, scope and guaranteed service windows. I compared GPT, Gemini, Llama and DeepSeek with several preprocessing strategies and a resilience test, in about 16,000 LLM calls over 61 benchmark runs, reaching an F1-score above 0.95 on field extraction.

bamboosim.title: BambooSIM
bamboosim.description: Live commercial travel-eSIM store. After checkout the backend provisions the data plan automatically against the carrier's eSIM API and returns a working profile and QR code in seconds, handling top-ups and plan extensions on the same flow. Multi-gateway payments (card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay) in local currencies, plus a custom CMS for catalogue, orders and customers.

qrami.title: Qrami
qrami.description: Booking and clinical-workflow platform for an Italian health-tech startup, run as a SaaS on Stripe Connect. PostGIS geofenced matching between patients and doctors, multi-stage escalation with timed fallbacks on BullMQ, and Redis locks against concurrent accepts.

iotdashboard.title: IoT Dashboard
iotdashboard.description: Industrial dashboard for monitoring and controlling fleets of IoT sensors. Time-series ingestion and querying on TimescaleDB hypertables with SQL Continuous Aggregates, keeping dashboards responsive over long time ranges. Eclipse Kapua handles device management and telemetry.

ianus.title: Janus
ianus.description: Double-entry accounting engine for Italian VAT-registered freelancers: invoicing, VAT, payment schedules, cash flow and depreciation. The whole system is driven from a chat interface: an LLM layer with function calling and structured output turns plain-language requests into accounting operations, with RAG over the user's own documents.

vhfesuperiori.title: VHF e superiori
vhfesuperiori.description: Event platform and social network for an Italian amateur-radio association, in production and open source, with 400+ users and 62 events so far. It parses uploaded ADIF/EDI contact logs, geolocates Maidenhead grid squares and renders QSO maps server-side using Puppeteer. It also generates personalised eQSL cards from templates and batches them into daily digest emails to stay within provider quotas. TypeScript monorepo with Express, MongoDB and a React front end.

kinocafe.title: Kinó Café
kinocafe.description: Management system for Kinó Café, a volunteer-run café in San Cesario sul Panaro that I also ran in person. Members sign up online with a digital signature and check in with a QR code. The tablet POS drives an ESP32 customer display over Web Serial and sends receipts via Socket.IO to a Python client that prints them on an ESC/POS thermal printer. NestJS, Prisma and PostgreSQL behind a React front end.

ezaffitto.title: ezaffitto
ezaffitto.description: Microservice pipeline that scrapes rental listings from several sources and normalises unstructured ad text into a queryable schema with OpenAI extraction. Node.js and Python services orchestrated with Docker.
